name: omnisense/omnimap
description: Omnimap: maps under any PHP host, whoever draws them - one description of a view (centre, zoom, markers) that a provider's driver draws in the browser, the provider's image of it made on the server, geocoding over geocoder-php, and the map cache: the picture of a view, signed, cut in tiles, kept in a storage of the host's and served from it, captured by the browser or made by the server. Providers are packages of their own (omnimap/google, omnimap/openstreetmap); the Symfony and Laravel bridges live in omnibridge.

suggest.ext-gd: The map cache: a picture cut in tiles (Snapshot\SnapshotStore::save()), tiles put together (Static\TileStitcher)
suggest.league/flysystem: The map cache in a Flysystem storage (Snapshot\FlysystemStorage): local, S3, SFTP...
suggest.phpunit/phpunit: The conformance suite a provider runs (Testing\ProviderContractTests), with symfony/http-client
suggest.omnimap/google: Google Maps: the Maps JavaScript API, Static Maps, geocoding
suggest.omnimap/maplibre: MapLibre: vector styles drawn by MapLibre GL JS in the browser (OpenFreeMap's by default, no key)
suggest.omnimap/openstreetmap: OpenStreetMap: Leaflet over an OSM tile server, images made of its tiles, Nominatim's geocoding
suggest.omnisense/omnibridge: The host contracts; omnibridge/symfony and omnibridge/laravel wire omnimap into their host
suggest.omnisense/omnidrive: The map cache on an omnidrive Drive (Snapshot\DriveStorage): the storage an application names, wherever it is
